name: breeze_slash
concept: A fully-visible upright cigarette centered on a warm cream ground, marked by a true no-smoking symbol: a thick red prohibition ring with a diagonal slash crossing the cigarette near-perpendicular to its axis.
palette: Warm cream-to-amber ground, ivory cigarette with amber filter and dark tip, bold red ring and slash

concept: A single chunky cigarette snapped clean in two — two short fat rounded halves (320px tall, ~60% of canvas) angled apart with one bold dark zig-zag V-notch break between them. Left half capped with a big amber filter, right half a slim grey ash tip. No thin bar, no seam lines, no hairlines: one decisive shape that stays legible at 60px.
palette: Mint-to-teal vertical gradient ground, ivory cigarette body, amber filter cap, dark espresso jagged break edges

palette: Charcoal ground, pale teal ashtray disc, ivory cigarette body, tan filter, red ember glow

concept: A cigarette whose glowing ember directly sprouts a single bold leaf — harm transforming into renewal. The leaf base overlaps the ember so it visibly grows from the tip. Deep teal ground makes the ivory cigarette and green leaf pop with strong figure/ground contrast.
palette: Deep teal ground, ivory cigarette, amber-orange ember, vibrant green leaf

palette: Deep indigo-night ground, ivory cigarette with amber-lit tip, bright cyan-to-white bird

name: breeze_check
concept: A cigarette resolving into a bold green checkmark of freedom — the short stub forms the down-stroke, a confident tick rises from it. Success, done, victory.
palette: Clean off-white ground, ivory cigarette stub, bold emerald checkmark

name: breeze_split
concept: A vertical split icon embodying the choice: the left half is a single bold ivory cigarette standing upright in its own dark dusk field; the right half is one chunky deep-green leaf silhouette centered in a bright green field. Two solid silhouettes, each self-contained in its half, never crossing the seam.
palette: Left ground warm dusk plum (#3A3340); right ground fresh green (#34B364). Ivory cigarette (#F4F1EA) with amber filter (#E8A33D); deep forest-green leaf (#0F5C2E). Thin ivory seam divider.

name: Б — emerald monolith
concept: A heavy, confident Cyrillic Б built as one solid ivory monolith on a deep emerald gradient ground. The bowl is a fat squared-shoulder block with a TRUE punched counter (evenodd hole) so the emerald ground shows straight through — no stuck-on disc. Square outer shoulder and the top arm make the Б unmistakable at 60px. Calm, healthy, premium brand core.
palette: deep emerald ground (#065f46 → #022c22), ivory letter (#f4fbf7)

name: Б — teal breath counter
concept: A confident geometric Cyrillic Б on a single teal gradient ground. The bowl is a fat filled white block; ONE big leaf/lung is cut clean out of it as TRUE background-colored negative space, reading instantly as a held breath. Bold silhouette, legible at 60px.

name: Б — ivory ground navy letter
concept: Inverted ground: warm off-white field with a bold deep-navy Б. Editorial, trustworthy, premium-clinical without being medical. Heaviest weight of the set with a square-ish counter for a serious, ownable mark.
palette: ivory ground (#f5f3ec), deep navy letter (#1e3a5f)

name: Б — sky gradient airy
concept:
Fresh-air feel: a soft sky-blue vertical gradient ground (dawn breeze, light cyan up top fading to a deep blue base) carries one clean, bold white Б. The counter is cut as a true hole in the white letter so the sky gradient shows through it — no separate colored circle, no third color. The hole is shrunk and shifted right (center ~532) leaving a thick 64px white wall on the stem side and ~50px on the outer-right side; its inner-left edge is a flat vertical wall and only the right edge curves, so it reads as a proper Б bowl rather than a floating circle. Lightest, most weightless icon of the set, fully filled silhouette, legible at 60px.</parameter>
<parameter name="palette">sky gradient ground (#7dd3fc → #38bdf8 → #2563eb), white letter, counter is a transparent gradient hole

name: Б — gold on forest
concept: Premium luxe pairing: a warm champagne-gold Cyrillic Б on a rich forest-green ground, reading as a high-end rewarding-milestone brand. The bowl is a single round shape with an evenly-centered, equal-wall rectangular counter, and the top arm bonds straight into the stem — an unmistakable, symmetrical, expensive silhouette legible at 60px.
palette: forest ground gradient (#1b452d to #0b2114), champagne gold letter (#e8c879)

concept: Warm, encouraging variant so the set isn't all cool greens: a soft coral-to-rose gradient ground with a clean cream Б. Friendly and motivational. Tall slim stem with a rounded counter — the most approachable silhouette of the eight.
palette: coral gradient ground (#fb7185 → #e11d48), cream letter (#fff7f3)

name: Б — green air-dot counter
concept: A bold deep-pine Cyrillic Б on a fresh spring-green ground. The bowl of the Б cradles ONE large, bright air-bubble — a clean filled circle rising upward inside the bowl — reading instantly as exhaled, lighter, free air. The tiny dark floating speck is gone; the single bubble alone carries the breath idea, and the solid bowl alone carries the letter. Clean silhouette, one gradient, ownable and energetic.
palette: spring-green ground (#a7f3d0 → #34d399), deep pine letter (#06402b), bright mint air-bubble (#d9fbe9)

name: Two-tone lung pair
concept: Two bold lung lobes fused with a thick, short trachea into one continuous solid silhouette — a hard center split divides off-white from deep mint so the lungs read instantly at 60px. Trachea is widened to ~120px and shortened, with chunky Y-bronchi rooting it into each lobe so nothing floats. Deep teal gradient ground.
palette: Deep teal gradient ground (#0E7C7B to #053238); left lobe off-white #EAFBF5; right lobe deep mint #34D9A6; thin teal split line for separation

name: Split lungs with airway and alveoli
concept: Two bold filled lung lobes separated by a clear background-notch gap, with a thick dark windpipe and two mint alveoli dots. High value contrast between an emerald lobe and a deep-green lobe keeps the two-lung split readable at 60px; mint dots stay visible against the light ground.
palette: Off-white ground #F2F5F3; dark green trachea #14342E; left lobe emerald #19B97E; right lobe deep green #0A5C40; alveoli dots mint #BFF4E0 and #7DEFC9

name: Lung wings
concept: Two bold solid-white wings sweep up and outward from a short central airway-stem, lifting like ascending flight. A narrow negative-space gap down the centerline keeps the wings separate and the airway is shortened and thickened into the joint, so the silhouette reads as bold ascending breath at 60px. Stepped angled top edges feather upward like real wings instead of drooping inward like lungs.
palette: Blue-to-violet diagonal gradient ground (#3B5BFF to #7A3BFF); solid white wings; centerline negative-space gap reveals the ground for separation. No pale facets.

name: Lungs as leaves
concept: Lungs rendered as two bold dark-green leaves fused with a stem-trachea into one solid mark. Veins are no longer thin strokes — they are cut OUT of the solid leaves as thick negative-space wedges (a wide central midrib plus two branching ribs per leaf), letting the bright leaf-green ground show through. The trachea pill overlaps into both leaf bodies so the whole thing reads as a single confident silhouette.
palette: Vivid leaf-green vertical gradient ground (#A6F571 top to #2A9E55 bottom); near-black forest-green leaf mass #0B3A20; negative-space veins reveal the green ground through the dark leaves.

name: White lungs on coral
concept: Clean white solid lung pair with two alveoli dots punched out, on a warm energetic coral ground — friendly, approachable, high-contrast. The light-on-warm counterpoint to the dark grounds.
palette: Coral ground #FF6B5C; white lobes #FFFFFF and pale blush #FFE3DE; cut-out dots in coral and light coral

name: Fresh breath exhale
concept: A bold centered 'fresh breath' glyph: one solid cyan-to-blue disc as the breath source, exhaling three thick rounded bars of graduated length that fan slightly upward and outward. Solid disc (no donut cutout) reads as a clear source; graduated short-long-short lengths with an upward sweep read unmistakably as exhaled air, not motion blur. Centered in a deep charcoal tile.
palette: Charcoal ground #0E1626; solid disc cyan-to-blue gradient #34E0FF to #3B82F6; cyan breath bars #34E0FF with the longest bar carrying a subtle cyan-to-soft-blue gradient for depth

name: Two-tone lung silhouette
concept: A single bold pair of lung lobes carved from two solid tones of green, split down the middle by one thick (~62px) airway groove cut in the mint ground color. No inner ribs, no hairlines — just a clean, confident anatomical silhouette with a short, wide central trachea so the mark reads instantly as lungs even at 60px. Sits on a soft white-to-mint ground for a calm, premium quit-smoking feel.
palette: Soft white-to-mint gradient ground (#FFFFFF to #D7ECE6); right lobe deep emerald #0B7A59, left lobe bright emerald #0E9E74; central airway groove cut as negative space in the mint ground color

name: breeze_solid_leaf
concept: A single bold leaf as a solid filled shape on a warm cream ground, tilted ~15° for energy. The negative-space split IS the divider: one confident diagonal cream gap (~52px) separates the leaf into a deep-emerald half and a lighter mint half, giving depth without a single thin vein. No worm strokes — pure filled two-tone silhouette that reads as a fresh, calm wellness mark instantly at 60px.
palette: Warm cream ground (#F4F1E8), deep emerald (#0C6E50), lighter mint (#22B083), with the cream gap reusing the ground tone as the seam

name: breeze_wind_sprout
concept: A bold sprout reimagined as motion: a fat, confidently tapered stem (~90px) rises from a deep forest ground, splitting into one large filled leaf and a mirrored smaller leaf. A single thick filled wind crescent sweeps horizontally through the foliage in a pale mint tone, reading clearly as "Бриз/breeze" — growth carried on the wind rather than a generic static sprout. Strong vertical silhouette, all filled shapes, generous negative space, legible at 60px.
palette: Deep forest ground gradient (#12543F to #06231A), fresh-lime leaves (#5BD685 / #3BC270), warm green stem (#2E9E6E), pale mint breeze crescent (#D7F8E4)

name: breeze_leaf_lung
concept: One solid, symmetrical leaf that reads simultaneously as a healthy pair of lungs. The two lobes are fused into a single filled silhouette that meets cleanly along the centerline; the airway is carved purely as negative space — a wide V-notch splitting the top edge that flows down into a tapering central vein. No floating stem, no dot, no thin tubes. Bold geometric form on a calm sky-mint ground for a premium quit-smoking app.
palette: Soft sky-mint ground (#E6F7F0), single teal-to-emerald gradient leaf (#16B083 → #0B6B50), airway/vein read as negative ground showing through

name: breeze_air_drop
concept: A bold solid drop of fresh air — a clean teardrop silhouette on a light ground, with a small crisp leaf cut into negative space at its center. Single tasteful vertical gradient. Premium, minimal, calm. Reads as purity and freshness.
palette: Pale aqua ground (#EAF6F8), aqua-to-teal gradient drop (#3FD0C9 → #1A9B97), white negative leaf

name: breeze_pine_needle
concept: A bold modern fir frond mark — one unified bright-green sprig where a thick central stem and chunky needle blades fuse into a single shape. Needles angle sharply upward in a V/chevron rhythm like a real evergreen branch, capped by a crisp triangular tip. Strong vertical silhouette, generous negative space, deep charcoal-teal ground for fresh-air contrast.
palette: Charcoal-teal ground (#16312C), single vivid pine green for the whole mark (#34C77B) with a subtle brighter-to-deeper vertical gradient (#5FE39A to #2BB36E) for premium depth

name: breeze_wind_leaf
concept: A single bold, flat spring-green leaf centered on a fresh sky-blue ground with one thick white center vein. Three white wind capsules sweep across so the breeze visibly interacts with the leaf.
palette: Sky-blue gradient ground (#4FB6F0 to #2E8FD8), flat solid spring-green leaf (#1FB562), white vein and wind capsules (#FFFFFF)

name: breeze_heart_leaf
concept: A bold leaf-heart fusion mark. Two solid green lobes meet in a soft cleft at top and taper to a single point at the bottom, with the right lobe drawn out into a recognizable pointed leaf tip so the foliage reading survives alongside the heart. The leaf is carved with confident negative-space cuts in the pale-sage ground color: a wide tapering midrib runs from cleft to tip and three chunky angled vein wedges branch off it. No hairline strokes — every cut is a solid filled wedge thick enough to stay legible at 60px.
palette: Warm pale-sage ground #EDF4E4; single vertical gradient leaf-heart #46C778 to #178A4B; midrib and veins as pale-sage negative space matching the ground

name: breeze_leaf_circle
concept: A single bold mint leaf centered inside a solid teal disc — premium emblem treatment. The leaf is one crisp filled shape with a pronounced pointed tip and broad shoulders so the silhouette is unmistakably a leaf, not a ball. A single straight negative-space midline (70px gap) splits it cleanly down the center, revealing the disc through the cut. Ownable, badge-like, legible at 60px.
palette: Deep teal disc (#0E5C52) on near-black field (#08221E), bright mint leaf (#54E0A4)

name: Ascending air
concept: A bold solid chevron lifting upward, echoed by a second smaller chevron rising beneath it — pure upward momentum reading as breath, freedom and the lift of quitting. Deep teal-to-petrol vertical gradient ground gives a premium, calm-yet-confident feel; the bright mint and green chevrons pop hard for a crisp 60px silhouette.
palette: deep teal #0e7c86 to petrol #063a52 ground; mint #eafff6 and green #7fe3c4 marks

name: Open ring
concept: A solid emerald ring with a single clean cut/opening at the lower-right and a free dot floating in the gap — an abstract lung opening, a breath escaping, a closed loop deliberately broken (freedom). Warm cream ground keeps it light, friendly and premium against the bold green; the gap gives a memorable, ownable silhouette.
palette: warm cream #f4efe4 ground; emerald #10a37f mark

name: Inhale exhale
concept: A single bold upward chevron built from two thick pill-capped strokes — the universal silhouette of a breath lifting. The left arm is bright cyan (the rising inhale), the right arm a deeper teal-green (the settling exhale), separated in both hue and value so they never blur into one blob. A navy gap-wedge cuts the apex where they meet, so the two-stroke seam survives all the way down to 60px and reads as an interlocking ^, not a lumpy capsule. Round pill caps keep it calm and premium; the deep navy ground makes the marks luminous.
palette: Navy ground #0e1830; rising arm bright cyan #54d2ff; settling arm deep teal-green #2f9e7a with a lime tip #9cf07a; navy gap #0e1830

name: Breathing target
concept: A bold concentric breathing target — thick white filled rings around a solid center dot, the Calm/Headspace gesture of guided breathing. The single blue-to-violet diagonal gradient ground feels modern and serene; rings at graded opacity create depth while the dead-center dot anchors a clean, calm focal point.
palette: blue #3a6df0 to violet #7b3ff0 gradient ground; white #ffffff rings

concept: An unmistakable origami paper bird mid-glide, built from two bold filled facets with a clear gull-wing silhouette and a pointed head, filling ~75% of the canvas on a pale sky gradient.
palette: sky gradient pale #cdeffb to blue #3f9bdb ground; white #ffffff near-wing, deep-blue #1f6fb0 body/far-wing, mid-blue #2f8bcb fold accent

name: Breeze of air
concept: A bold filled B for Breeze where the upper counter is broken open and streams out to the right edge as a band of escaping air, trailed by three fading breeze dots. The two bowls are deliberately asymmetric — a small upper counter and a large rounded lower sweep — so the silhouette signals air flowing through rather than a stock font B. Mint-to-deep-green diagonal ground, near-white letterform, one focal monogram with generous negative space.
palette: mint #1fd4a3 to deep green #08855f gradient ground; near-white #eafff8 letterform; pale-mint #bdfbe6 to white air band

name: Fresh drop
concept: A bold solid upward-pointing teardrop/leaf — a single unit of fresh, clean air rising — split into a brighter and deeper green half for dimensional depth without any gradient. Dark forest ground makes the greens glow; one confident filled form, strong vertical silhouette that reads instantly even at 60px.
palette: dark forest #0b2e2a ground; bright green #3ee6a4 and deep green #1fb985 mark

name: Breath crescent
concept: Two bold, thick crescents nested concentrically and centered on a coral-to-pink ground: a large cream crescent cradles a smaller peach one, like a breath holding a calm pause. Both crescents open the same direction so the peach clearly reads INSIDE the cream — a warm, human, ownable silhouette that stays legible at 60px. The thinnest part of each crescent stays above 120px so there are no tapering horns.
palette: coral #ff7a59 to pink #ff4d8d diagonal gradient ground; cream #fff4ec outer crescent; peach #ffc9a3 inner crescent
